_about: Inputs of the friction-cone explainer. Planar cross-sections: world x right, z up, +y into the drawing; all forces act on the box. Single view: a box at rest on a horizontal table, pushed horizontally by f_p (positive from the left face towards +x); the table's contact resultant acts at its centre of pressure x_cp = h f_p / (m g) from T, the support midpoint (moment balance about T); rest needs f_n = m g and f_t = -f_p, admissible when |f_p| <= mu_f m g. The required force is drawn at x_cp while rest is possible and, beyond the friction limit, at the limit's centre of pressure (+-mu_f h from T; T at mu_f = 0); when it lies outside the cone the contact cannot supply it and friction cannot maintain rest (no clipped arrow stands in for a physical response). Pair view: two opposed side contacts with inward normals; the solid arrow is an admissible example (f_n kept, requested f_t clipped), gravity omitted. Force ranges are exploration ranges, not hardware limits.

pushedBox._about: Single view. Wide box, low push: the centre of pressure x_cp = h f_p / (m g) stays within the base (|x_cp| <= a) for every control value (|x_cp| <= 0.015 x 15 / (0.5 x 9.81) = 0.046 m) and within mu_f h <= 0.015 m whenever friction permits rest; the tipping push a m g / h = 4 m g (at least 19.6 N) is above the sliding push mu_f m g (at most 14.7 N) and above the largest push, so sliding is the first limit throughout the controls. Moments about T; the weight acts at the centre of mass, h_com = height / 2 above the table.

push._unit: N, horizontal push on the box; positive from the left face towards +x

ft._unit: N, requested tangential force, upward positive

mu._unit: friction coefficient, shared by both views

snap._about: N: a handle drag landing within this of +-mu_f m g (mu_f m g > 0) sticks to the limit (a detent +-0.25 N, about 7 px wide); slider input snaps within half a step; zero push never snaps

tolerance._about: Absolute tolerances in N and N m. A force whose |f_t| equals mu_f f_n within tolerance.force lies on the cone boundary; presets match by value within tolerance.match. A nonzero push within half a slider step (slider) or within snap.dragWindow N (handle drag) of the friction limit snaps to the limit exactly.

hidden._about: Inputs of the view that is not shown: a single-view preset carries these pair contacts, a pair preset this push and mass.

inside.label: Box: comfortably supported
inside.observation: Rest needs 3 N of friction; the table can supply up to 4.905 N.

boundary.label: Box: at the friction limit
boundary.observation: |f_t| = mu_f m g = 4.905 N: at the friction limit, no reserve.

outside.label: Box: beyond the limit
outside.observation: Rest would need 7 N of friction, more than 4.905 N: friction cannot maintain rest.

clockwise.label: Pair: clockwise couple
clockwise.observation: tau_y = 0.18 N m; zero resultant force.
